basis.method: read-only: Read/Grep/Glob/git on files at the clean checkout of e64eacd; no cargo/rustc/nextest, no binary or window launched. Reachability decided by reading the only window host (crates/hsk-studio-harness/src/bin/studio-harness.rs hosts Viewer::ui and nothing else) and every caller of each open_* entry point in the view crate. Test proof kind decided by reading the tests' egui use (ctx.run with RawInput; grep for pointer/key events found none in crates/hsk-studio-harness/tests).

evidence_level_definitions.PASS_JUDGED_HEADLESS: the surface's lane is PASS_Vn in the ledger (judged at or before 237256f, pre-split); proof is headless (state, one-frame egui draw, document pixels), never a window
evidence_level_definitions.READY_UNJUDGED: covering lane READY_FOR_VALIDATION; tests exist but no independent verdict
evidence_level_definitions.TESTED_NO_LANE: tests exist but no lane claims the surface
evidence_level_definitions.UNTESTED: code exists; no test located that exercises this behaviour
evidence_level_definitions.STUB_OR_REFUSAL: the surface exists only as a typed refusal or carried-not-imported placeholder

reach_classes.WINDOW_DOCUMENTED_BUILD: a widget, shortcut or canvas gesture in the desktop window built as RUN-UI.md documents (--features desktop)
reach_classes.WINDOW_FEATURE_BUILD: a widget in the desktop window only when built with extra features that RUN-UI.md does not mention (media, audio-batch, audio-device, audio-plugin, media-native)
reach_classes.VIEWER_API_ONLY: a public Viewer method (and possibly an egui panel that draws once opened) with no widget, menu, shortcut or file-open path in the window that reaches it; a user of the window cannot get there
reach_classes.NOT_HOSTED: an egui surface that the desktop binary never instantiates
reach_classes.CLI: the headless studio-harness example command line (not a GUI)

headless_proof_kinds_found: STATE: Viewer methods called directly, assertions on Viewer::state_json(), Run ops/history, saved and reopened packages (most tests)

DRAW1: one egui frame drawn into a bare egui::Context via ctx.run(RawInput{screen_rect}) and assertions on Viewer::drawn() (the viewer's own list of widget names it drew) and that drawing committed nothing; no input events are injected (grep for PointerButton/PointerMoved/Event::Key/Event::Text in crates/hsk-studio-harness/tests: 0 hits), so no widget is ever clicked through egui
DOCPX: document composite pixels (render-cpu Frame rgba8 / tile bytes / exported file decoded back) asserted, mostly on small synthetic documents; these are document pixels, not UI pixels

AK: AccessKit tree produced headlessly (ctx.enable_accesskit, output.platform_output.accesskit_update) asserted only as nodes.len() > 20, only with feature desktop (crates/hsk-studio-harness/tests/viewer_edit.rs:168-186)

GPU_SHARED: render on a host wgpu device into the display texture with a headless egui-wgpu RenderState (crates/hsk-studio-harness/tests/viewer_shared_display.rs); the test returns early with no assertion when no adapter is available (line 91: let Some(state) = host_state() else { return })

NOT FOUND: egui_kittest (0 hits in any Cargo.toml or .rs), Argus inspect/click/set_value/screenshot implementation in the harness crates (the harness, harness-core, harness-view and controls sources contain no 'argus'), UI screenshots or UI-pixel snapshots, real window launch, simulated pointer/keyboard input

surfaces.proves: STATE + DOCPX (viewer open of a synthetic 2x2 PSD with pixels; import routes into native packages)
surfaces.notes: opens in the window: PSD/PSB, TIFF (incl. Photoshop layer records), PNG, JPEG, camera raw (DNG; CR2/CR3/ORF/RW2/RAF by magic; TIFF-container raws through develop), native .handshake. Not opened as content: PDF (carried, empty document + pdf_pages_not_imported receipt), Illustrator .ai (PDF-compatible .ai starts with %PDF- and therefore lands in the carried-PDF route; editable AI import is Viewer::import_ai API only), WebP (refused webp_decoder_unavailable), Affinity .af* (refused affinity_native_use_export), .fig, .svg, .idml, video files (no sniff route; they fall to the native-package opener and fail). Audio files open only in builds with feature media.
